claims.claim: Engine oil pump balance shaft assembly for Toyota Camry (2018-present), RAV4
claims.evidence: Witness identifies this as a disassembled manual transmission/gearbox housing with gear teeth, bearings, and casing marked '5-B' — not an oil pump balance shaft assembly, which is a much smaller component.
No shipping documents, customs paperwork, or country-of-origin markings visible in any photo.
Photos show the unit fully disassembled into separate housing pieces with guide rods through it — not an assembled, running unit that could be tested as described.
No odometer, donor vehicle documentation, or wear-pattern close-up provided.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show the casing split apart with internal gears, bearings, and bolts exposed, and separate housing sections removed.

risks.risk: Fundamental mismatch between seller's stated part (oil pump balance shaft assembly) and the actual item shown (transmission/gearbox housing)
risks.proof: Seller must confirm exact part name matching the photos, or provide new photos matching the claimed part
risks.if_unproven: treat as unidentified/mismatched listing, not priceable as described

risks.risk: Unknown completeness of gearbox internals (shafts, synchros, clutch housing)
risks.proof: Full photo/video of all disassembled parts laid out together with shafts and synchro rings visible

risks.risk: Condition of gear teeth, bearings, and seals unknown
risks.proof: Close-up clips of each gear tooth surface and bearing race under good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn/unknown condition, not as new

risks.risk: No way to confirm vehicle fitment (make/model/engine)
risks.proof: Casting number or VIN-tag photo matched to a parts catalogue
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, generic used gearbox core value only

risks.risk: Origin and import claim (Belgium, tokunbo) unverifiable
risks.proof: Photo of shipping label, bill of lading, or customs clearance paper
risks.if_unproven: ignored for pricing purposes, treated as unverifiable

proof_requests: Photo/video of the complete assembly laid out, including shafts, synchros, and clutch housing if present
Close-up video of gear teeth and bearing surfaces under good lighting
Casting/part number clearly photographed for fitment verification
Any documentation (import papers, invoice) supporting Belgium origin and tokunbo status
Seller to clarify why described part (oil pump balance shaft) does not match photographed item (gearbox housing)
response.reason: The seller's description of an 'engine oil pump balance shaft assembly' does not match the witness's identification of a disassembled manual transmission/gearbox housing, and claims of 'never opened' and 'tested and working' are directly contradicted by photos showing the unit taken apart.
